text:
deploy-bot: post-deploy report for v2.14.1 \u2014 quick summary: 6/8 probes green, 1 degraded (rerank synthetic), 1 failing (modelproxy 503s) in ap-southeast-1. holding remaining canary shards.

release-manager: flagged during the 10:00UTC rollout. can we get failure probe ids and affected host-groups?

deploy-bot: degraded: [rerank-014], failing: [mp-503-01]. hosts: host-203 (modelproxy 503s), host-group-ap-rt-1 saw higher p95 on embed requests.

lina: any correlation with the recent modelvariant swap? we flipped mv-beta-3 earlier in canary.

infra-bot: change:mv-swap recorded at 2026-03-21T09:55:02Z user=release-manager commit=ae3f7b9

ops_tess: i'm on call. pulling logs from host-203 now. if it's repeated 503s we'll likely do a targeted modelproxy restart and consider routing that host-group to previous modelvariant.

ryan: if we route entire host-group back, we should keep autoscaler policies intact (no scale-down during immediate window). also want a short release-note into the changelog about targeted rollback.

ops_tess: logs tail:
```
2026-03-21T09:58:11Z ERROR modelproxy upstream 503 backend=mv-beta-3 host=host-203 req_id=abcd-1234
2026-03-21T09:58:12Z WARN model-loader slow-unload id=mv-beta-3 duration=4.2s host=host-203
2026-03-21T09:58:13Z INFO kernel meminfo: RSS spike detected; cgroup memory=12.1GiB limit=12GiB
```

lina: memory pressure on host-203. may be a model variant memory regression. propose: 1) pin routing for host-group-ap-rt-1 back to v2.14.0 modelvariant; 2) drain host-203 and restart modelproxy process; 3) pause further canary shards until validation.

release-manager: agree with targeted approach. keep canary halted for ap region only; proceed with pin and restart. aim to keep outage <10m for that host-group.

ops_tess: running commands now: `rbctl pin --group host-group-ap-rt-1 --version v2.14.0 --reason "modelproxy 503s/memory spike"` then `hostctl drain host-203 --timeout 90s` then `systemctl restart redwood-modelproxy`. will post updates.

ops_tess: pin applied. drain started.

deploy-bot: reroute executed for pinned group. follow-up probes scheduled at 15s interval for that group.

infra-bot: event: host-203 drain complete; cordon=true; replacing traffic.

ops_tess: restart completed. running quick probes...

deploy-bot: follow-up probe results: rerank-014 ok, mp-503-01 ok on host-203, embed p95 in ap-southeast-1 reduced from 260ms -> 145ms.

ryan: nice. recommend we leave the pin for 12 hours and open infra ticket to bisect mv-beta-3 memory footprint. i'll add a changelog bullet: "post-deploy: targeted pin of AP routing after modelvariant memory spike; host restarted and monitoring extended."

lina: also schedule a constrained-change-window hotfix tomorrow 04:00UTC for infra to test mv-beta-3 with extra mem limits. mention in release notes.

release-manager: done. added to release notes and posted to release calendar. tagging infra-team and scheduling follow-up.

ops_tess: marking thread as stable for now. will reopen if probes regress.

deploy-bot: closing canary shard for ap-southeast-1; other regions continue rollout.

release-manager: good work. keep an eye on autoscaler alarms and evict noisy tenants if they surface. closing this thread in 2h unless reopened. :thumbsup:
